activity: Entry into manhole, drain, tank, pipe or confined space
mandatory_controls: Standby person outside the confined space
additional_controls: Maintain communication between entrant and standby person
Display warning signs and restrict access
Record oxygen, flammable gas, carbon monoxide and hydrogen sulphide readings where applicable
competent_person_required: Competent Person for confined space assessment
emergency_response: Do not enter for rescue without proper rescue equipment
Use rescue equipment by trained personnel
Evacuate the area if gas alarm is triggered
common_ra_mistakes: Confined space treated as normal work area
ai_checker_rules: If confined space is detected, permit, competent person, approved worker, gas testing, ventilation, standby person and rescue arrangement must be included.

mandatory_controls: Inspect electrical cables and plugs before use
Separate water supply from electrical connection
Use waterproof socket and suitable low voltage tool where required
Provide eye protection and anti-slip control
additional_controls: Provide warning signs and restrict access
Support cut section before final separation
permit_required: Hot work permit if spark / heat is generated
Electrical permit if connected to temporary power system
competent_person_required: Qualified electrician if electrical setup is involved
emergency_response: In case of electric shock, isolate power before rescue
Stop work and provide first aid
Tag defective equipment and remove from service
common_ra_mistakes: Wet coring listed without electrical safety controls
ai_checker_rules: If wet coring is detected and no electrical safety control is included, classify as critical or revise required.

mandatory_controls: Valid test and examination certificates for crane and lifting gear
Lifting plan for non-routine or high-risk lifting
Check ground condition and outrigger setup where applicable
additional_controls: Use tag line for long or unstable load
Do not allow workers under suspended load
permit_required: Lifting permit where required by site system
emergency_response: Stop lifting immediately if load becomes unstable
Inspect lifting gear and lifting method before resuming
common_ra_mistakes: No emergency response for suspended load
ai_checker_rules: If lifting operation is detected, the RA must include certificate, competent persons, exclusion zone and inspection points.

activity: Work on scaffold, platform, roof edge, ladder or elevated location
mandatory_controls: Guardrails and toe boards where applicable
Fall arrest system and independent lifeline where required
Set exclusion zone below work area
Secure tools and materials against falling
additional_controls: Confirm rescue arrangement for fall arrest
permit_required: Working at height permit where required by site system
competent_person_required: Competent person for scaffold / platform inspection where applicable
common_ra_mistakes: No rescue plan for fall arrest
ai_checker_rules: If work at height is detected, fall prevention or fall arrest and falling object control must be included.

activity: Welding, flame cutting, grinding or other hot work
mandatory_controls: Fire watch during and after hot work
Control gas cylinders upright and secured
Check hoses, regulators and flashback arrestors
ai_checker_rules: If hot work is detected, permit, extinguisher, combustible control and fire watch must be included.

activity: Operation of forklift, excavator, loader, mobile plant or site vehicle
permit_required: Plant operation permit where required by site system
emergency_response: Report incident and inspect plant before reuse
ai_checker_rules: If plant movement is detected, plant-person segregation and operator control must be included.
